figures.Fig3.1: Robert Hooke's microscope and observation (PDF page 52). Original figure archived as c11-bio-ch3-fig-hooke (drawn for this lesson after the printed figure; not the textbook's picture). The photographs are drawn as a labelled microscope and a cork section.

findings: Book error shown as printed and marked: the book dates Virchow's observation to 1885, after Pasteur's 1862 proof of it; Book correction box gives 1855 (omnis cellula e cellula). The Roman Urdu states 1855 with a Kitab ki ghalti box.

Rewritten 2026-10-27 as printed: the book's wording, equations as equation blocks, lists and boxes as printed. The English lesson carries only the book's text; explanations, self-checks with answers and the recap are in the Roman Urdu lesson only.
